title: console: the console's own getIcon logs Lucide "Name in Lucide DynamicIcon not found" on the Settings hub — it has no known-name check, unlike app-shell's copy
body:
Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — console chrome | 缺项 | P2

Split by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` from objectui#11672 (the 2026-10-06 console dogfood sweep, showcase, framework `ce577ec4`), item 7. Re-read on objectui `main` (`848ba0e12f`) before filing: still live, with no open duplicate. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `apps/console/src/utils/getIcon.ts` (about `:31`–`:40`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the console copy hands any name to `DynamicIcon`, while `packages/app-shell/src/utils/getIcon.ts` (about `:46`) checks `iconNames` first.

## What happens

`/apps/setup/system/settings` and `/apps/setup/system/settings/company` each log `[lucide-react]: Name in Lucide DynamicIcon not found` twice, in en and zh-CN.

## Done when

- The console resolves icons through one helper with the known-name check. Either the console reuses app-shell's helper, or the two copies are made one.
- The unknown name behind the warning is found and named in the PR.
- **Pin:** an unknown icon name renders the fallback with no console error.
